name: framework-semantic-go-rewrite-matching-2853
instr:
Goravel source rewriting should recognize imported Go symbols by canonical identity, regardless of legal aliases, dot imports, qualification, or parentheses. Application recipes and generators should therefore update aliased layouts as reliably and idempotently as ordinary layouts. Ambiguous source must remain untouched and produce useful, deterministic diagnostics.

`Context`, `Resolution`, `ResolutionKind`, and `ContextualGoNode` from `github.com/goravel/framework/contracts/packages/match` resolve canonical imported identities while distinguishing local shadows and meaningful pointer or type differences. `NewContext`, `Qualified`, and `SemanticEqual` from `github.com/goravel/framework/packages/match` provide import-aware matching, while existing lexical `GoNode` implementations retain their `MatchNode` and `MatchCursor` behavior without adopting `ContextualGoNode`. Ambiguous identities report every viable candidate in canonical-path order and are never selected implicitly. Configuration recipes locate nested keys through chained and variable calls under every legal framework import alias. Configuration and registration recipes use this identity consistently for nested calls, typed slices, duplicate detection, anchors, import insertion, and removal. `MutationStatus`, `MutationReport`, `GoFile.FindResolved`, and `GoFile.ApplyResolved` from `github.com/goravel/framework/contracts/packages/modify` report matches, changes, unchanged results, and ambiguities deterministically, pr
